description: Reads the registrant list of one webinar as CSV text, the same export the dashboard downloads: one row per registrant with the columns the site writes. Read-only, it changes nothing. The text is capped at 20000 characters; when the list is longer the answer says so and how long it really is, and the full file is still the download in the dashboard. Personal data is returned only when the host's licence includes the registrant export. Use it when the host wants the list as a file for a spreadsheet or another tool. For reading and talking about the people use wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants, for one deletion wi_delete_registrant. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.
